data.body:
Revision 2, by lane ebf5 on 2026-10-19 against origin/main c0cf1022671. The description was rewritten. This comment carries the enumerations the description points to, and it replaces the first comment wherever the two differ.

**What changed from revision 1, and why**
Re-review on c0cf1022671 returned BLOCK. Seven findings were folded in:
- (1) `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py` needs edits beyond `:27`.
- (2) `infra/scripts/comment_echo_reclaim_manifest.py:28-39` has a by-path loader. It is a sibling of `_engine`, so it now imports `rebar.reconciler.inbound_fields`.
- (3) Five test modules import `_lib_ops._engine_module`.
- (4) `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` no longer exists (deleted by masonic-excusable-guppy). Only `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:96-97` carries the kwargs.
- (5) Rollback is now stated.
- (6) The disposition of the deleted fallbacks is now stated.
- (7) The 2 advisory items: the AC is split, and size stays as one story because a package rename cannot land half-done.

Coordinator decision applied: `pyproject.toml` is untouched, and T201 is handled with inline `# noqa: T201`. Follow-up likable-waterworn-willet (ab45-2cb2-c1b6-4c5b) records `discovered_from` this story and `depends_on` f7dc-132b-057a-476c; that edge was escalated to the epic.
`docs/exit-codes.md` is no longer touched: main's c0cf1022671 already removed its reconciler path.

**Out-of-package src callers**
- `_lib_ops.py`: `_engine_module` deleted. Callers use `importlib.import_module("rebar.reconciler.{projects_store,pass_support,__main__,mode,last_pass,_ref_lock,access_check}")`.
- `_bridge_runner.py:147-151`
- `_commands/bridge_repair.py:158-160`
- `_cli/_bridge_commands.py`: `_ref_lock_module` deleted along with its `_status` call. The `-m rebar.reconciler` argv is at `:50`.
- `mcp_server.py`: `_load_engine_mode` and `MODE_CAPS, Mode` deleted, plus the `ctx.MODE_CAPS` / `ctx.Mode` entries. The handle kwargs are dropped in `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py`, `tests/unit/test_gen_mcp_reference.py`, `tests/unit/test_cross_session_mcp.py`, and `tests/unit/test_mcp_plan_review_status.py`.
- Plain imports replace the `sys.path.insert` sites in `_cli/__init__.py`, `_commands/_repair_pause.py`, `_commands/doctor_mapping.py`, and `_commands/fsck_repair.py`.
- Plain imports replace the loaders in `_engine_support/bridge_fsck_drift.py` (classify) and `_engine_support/bridge_fsck_visibility.py` (access_check).
- `src/rebar/_engine/jira-capability-probe.py`: import path.
- `src/rebar/_engine.py`: `engine_env` and its docstrings.

**Prose-only src edits**
- `timeutils.py`, `_proc.py`, `_operation_config.py`, `_logging.py`, `_config_schema.py`, `_config_sections.py`, `_config_sources.py`
- `_store/push_state.py`, `schemas/__init__.py`
- `llm/eval_specs/plan-review-asserted-capability.eval.yaml`

**In-package loader sites rewritten**
- Prologues deleted in every module that had one.
- Hand-rolled loaders: `applier._load_concurrency`, `differ._load_sibling`/`_load_mutation`, `fetcher` alert_store, `inbound_collection_diffs`, `inbound_fields`, `inbound_translate`, `invariants` (alert_store, sink), `last_pass._load_ref_lock`, `binding_repository` alert_store, `outbound_pass` mutation_payloads, `pass_io` (conflict_resolver, alert_store).
- The `_load(name, relpath)` helpers in `reconcile`, `run_differs`, `pass_support`, `outbound_pass`, and `reconcile_helpers` are now `import_module` seams.
- `__main__._load_sibling_keyed` and `_try_load_step` are `import_module` seams.

**Type fixes**
- `adapters/jira/acli.py`: `AcliClient.update_issue(jira_key → remote_id)`. All 43 call sites pass it positionally.
- `apply_inbound_events._inbound_create_writeback_jira`: `client: TicketTransport | None`.
- `adapters/jira/summary_operation.py` and `adapters/jira_datacenter/summary_executor.py`: `doc: dict[str, Any]`.
- `adapters/jira_datacenter/_hierarchy.py`: `cached: Any`.
- `pass_io.mutate(data: MutableMapping[str, Any])`
- `outbound_mutation_builders.py`: asserts on `config.jira_snapshot` and `config.absent_alive_fields`. `compute_outbound_mutations` populates both before the loop.
- `manifest_renderer`: unconditional `retry_budget` import.

**Scripts**
- `capture_jira_fixtures.py`: drops its `sys.path.insert` and imports `rebar.reconciler.adapters.jira.{acli,acli_subprocess}`.
- Re-pointed to the new path: `check_cli_json_js_safe.py`, `check_config_ownership.py`, `check_fcntl_import_guard.py`, `check_raw_git_writes.py`, `generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py`, `jira_dc_capability_map.py`, `measure_baseline_normalization.py`, `measure_get_rotation_cutover.py`.
- `jira-pressure-test/{README.md,e2e_field_validation_probe.sh,e2e_validation_probe.sh}`: the `.sh` adf by-path load becomes an import.

**Docs**
`architecture`, `bug-creation-contract`, `code-navigation`, `concurrency`, `config`, `env-vars` (regenerated), `event-schema`, `jira-dc-capability-map`, `mapping-seam`, `migrations`, `release-notes` (a new BREAKING entry only; history is unedited), `remediation-implementation-plan`, `reuse-surface`, `user-guide`, plus `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.

**Tests deleted or rewritten** (all other test edits are mechanical)
- `tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py`:
  - The `:27` assertion is removed.
  - `test_library_path_exposes_no_generic_top_level_engine_names` asserts that `rebar_reconciler` is not importable.
  - `test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active` is rewritten as `test_engine_submodules_resolve_from_a_tests_unit_module`.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_main_entry.py::test_run_pass_returns_0_when_all_steps_absent` is deleted: it pinned the removed no-op.
- `test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py`: the `_loader.py`-exists contract now says it is deleted.
- `test_arg_sweep_kwargs_heldout.py`: paths updated.
- `test_transport_param_typing_cc77.py`: the absolute `rebar.reconciler._backend` spelling now resolves. The test still fails on the bare and `Any` spellings.
- `tests/_engine_path.py`, `tests/conftest.py::_one_engine_root`, and `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` are adjusted to `src/rebar/reconciler` and stay in place; S2 deletes them.

**Complexity re-spell** (6 keys, ceilings unchanged)
Old → new prefix: `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` → `src/rebar/reconciler/`.
- `adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py::_diff_fields` 32
- `applier.py::apply` 22
- `binding_walk.py::compute_binding_walk_mutations` 27
- `dispatch_one.py::create_one` 36
- `inbound_differ.py::_diff_jira_vs_local` 16
- `outbound_field_diff.py::diff_canonical_fields` 23

`--check` reports `active=28 new=0 increased=0 stale=21`.

**Measured so far on the scratch implementation**
- `make typecheck`: "Success: no issues found in 750 source files".
- Lint, the complexity check, and the mechanism check are green. The mechanism counts are `new=26` (all admitted) and `increased=0`, identical to main.
- `ruff check --select T201 --isolated src/rebar/reconciler` reports 0 findings.
- `gen_env_registry.py --check` is clean.
- The test conversion is in progress.
